INS identities are drawn from the standard Codex/FSSAI INS numbering system, but the specific category scopes and numeric limits below are PLACEHOLDER values for building and testing the pipeline. Verify every numeric limit and category scope against the current FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 gazette + amendments before using this file for real compliance decisions.
